introHtml: Poly propylene offers a lightweight, water-resistant alternative to traditional paper or vinyl materials for buttons, stickers, and patches. This synthetic material holds up well in outdoor conditions, making it ideal for giveaway items at trade shows, job fairs, or company picnics where exposure to moisture or rough handling is expected. Custom poly propylene buttons resist peeling and fading, while stickers maintain their shape and adhesion longer than standard paper stickers. Patches made from this material can be sewn or ironed onto uniforms or bags without fraying. Choose poly propylene for promotional products that need to endure beyond a single use.
